title: PagoYa — Cover
description: Cover: Pay any bill. Buy any gift card. In Mexico. Techstars pre-seed application June 2026.

title: The Problem
description: 65 million unbanked adults pay bills at OXXO — fees, time, disconnection risk, zero digital record.

title: The Solution
description: One wallet: pay utilities, buy gift cards (Netflix, Amazon, Spotify), confirmed via WhatsApp. $25 MXN flat.

title: What's Live Right Now
description: We didn't pitch this. We built it. 5 rails live: Stripe, SIPREL, Conekta/OXXO, Belvo, gift cards.

title: Market Size
description: Three markets: bill payments $180B MXN, digital gift cards $4.2B MXN, P2P transfers $42B MXN.

title: Business Model & Revenue
description: $25 MXN flat fee. Revenue table: 2x base to 5x target — $35M to $88M USD ARR at 1M wallets.

title: Go-To-Market
description: Street team + referral network: 3-layer MLM flywheel. Rep activates, earns passive commission, users refer users.

title: P2P: Payments Become Social
description: Next iteration: split bills, send balances, pay each other in WhatsApp. Each payment is a product demo.

title: The Data Moat
description: AI builds financial identity for 65M invisible people. Data unlocks credit, BNPL, insurance, microloans.

title: Infrastructure
description: 5 rails live: Stripe, SIPREL, Conekta/OXXO, Belvo, gift cards. STP/SPEI in progress. No intermediaries.

title: Competitive Landscape
description: Comparison table: OXXO Pay, Mercado Pago, Spin by OXXO vs. PagoYa. Only wallet for cash-first users.

title: Why Techstars
description: Regulatory nav, rep network scaling, Demo Day access to LATAM fintech investors who understand our unit economics.

title: The Ask
description: Pre-seed $150K–$500K USD on SAFE. 18-month runway. 1,000 active wallets milestone. FI Austin Summer 2026.
